command:
set -u
test ! -r /opt/qb560d-workshop/env.sh || . /opt/qb560d-workshop/env.sh
id -u
date -u
cat /etc/build_version
uname -a
command -v iperf3
iperf3 --version
iperf3 --help | grep -E 'bind-dev|connect-timeout|rcv-timeout|snd-timeout'
ip -4 addr show dev rmnet_data0
ip -4 route
ip -4 rule
cat /proc/loadavg
ps -eo pid,comm,pcpu | head -n 25
